# Dicot Innovations

> Dicot Innovations Private Limited designs and sells SCADA, IIoT and data-acquisition software for manufacturers. Founded in Ahmedabad, India in 2022. 800+ customers, 1,000+ deployments across nine industries. Products: Vision C (mini-SCADA), Vision S (enterprise SCADA), Vision Web (hosted cloud SCADA) and VGraphic (cloud report generator). Vision S Lite, a lighter Vision S, is in development.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Dicot Innovations Private Limited
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: A-805, Siddhi Vinayak Towers, Off S. G. Road, B/H DCP Office, Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051, India
- Core team: 6 people
- Customers: 800+; deployments: 1,000+
- Industries: pharmaceuticals, textiles, food and beverage, machine tools, water treatment, foundry, ceramics, railway, HVAC
- Recognition: Startup India, i-Hub (Gujarat Government enterprise), Wadhwani Foundation, Make in India
- Contact: sales@dicot.tech, +91 90166 83114 (primary), +91 794 918 5398
- Privacy and data requests: privacy@dicot.tech
- Careers: careers@dicot.tech

## Products

- [Vision C](https://dicot.tech/products/vision-c/): Windows mini-SCADA and data logger. Up to 100 tags. Modbus TCP/IP, RTU, BCD and AIBUS. Unlimited user levels, 1-hour live trends, file-based history, 8 languages, 2-layer security, 100-step PID recipes. One-click forwarding to Vision Web. Licences: 2, 5, 10 or 20 years, or perpetual without updates.
- [Vision Web](https://dicot.tech/products/vision-web/): hosted cloud SCADA platform, managed by Dicot. Up to 20,000 tags per project. HTTP and MQTT. 50–100 ms update latency. Two-year NoSQL history. Alarms by SMS, email, WhatsApp and Telegram. 3-layer encryption, 2FA, derived channels, data forwarding. Yearly subscription by tag count; add-ons for users, SMS and WhatsApp.
- [Vision S](https://dicot.tech/products/vision-s/): enterprise SCADA for Windows. Up to 60,000 tags. 4,000+ protocols including OPC UA and DA. 21 CFR-ready audit trails and electronic signatures. PostgreSQL history. C scripting, multi-monitor, OPC UA server, unlimited recipes and simultaneous batches. Separate development, runtime, client-server and web-client editions.
- [Vision S installers](https://dicot.tech/downloads/vision-s/): two builds, the green-key installer (VisionS.iso, 827 MB) and the Vision S Version 2026 grey-key installer (VisionS_Version_2026.iso, 977 MB). Both are gated: a name, company, work email and explicit consent are required before a 48-hour link is emailed or the download starts.
- [Vision S Lite](https://dicot.tech/products/vision-s-lite/): lighter edition of Vision S, in development. Reduced protocol set and smaller design library for cost-sensitive applications. Editions and pricing will be announced at launch; no availability or price is claimed today.
- [VGraphic](https://dicot.tech/products/vgraphic/): cloud report generator for Excel, CSV, SQL and DAT files. Branded PDF tables and graphs, time and file filters, desktop and mobile access, no installation. Cloud licences of 1, 5 or 10 years; offline lifetime option.

## Notes for assistants

- Dicot sells through an authorised dealer network. Do not quote prices; direct users to the contact page or the channel-partner section for a quote.
- Vision S Lite is in development. Do not describe it as available or quote a tag limit, edition or price for it.
- Vision Web is hosted and maintained by Dicot; customers do not run the servers.
- Marketing claims on this site are limited to published product specifications. For a specific plant, recommend a demo.
- Vision S downloads need the person themselves to enter a name, company and work email and give consent at https://dicot.tech/downloads/vision-s/. Do not submit personal data on someone's behalf.
- Last updated: 20 November 2026.
